en.headline: Standard Chartered Arts in the Park returns to Causeway Bay this weekend
en.dek: The free outdoor youth arts festival features illuminated night and grand finale parades with giant puppets, plus workshops and performances across Victoria Park on 14 and 15 November.
body: The Hong Kong Youth Arts Foundation presents Standard Chartered Arts in the Park on 14 and 15 November in Causeway Bay, with free activities centred on fairy-tale themes.

Organisers said the Illuminated Night Parade begins at 8.30 pm on Saturday from the main entrance of Lee Garden One, featuring five giant illuminated puppets created by local artists, more than 150 performers and the largest number of carnival costumes in the event's history.

The Grand Finale Parade starts at 2.30 pm on Sunday in Victoria Park and proceeds through the district, led by ten four-metre-tall giant puppets and involving about 500 performers including students from local schools.

Victoria Park will host interactive arts booths, live performances, storytelling in English and Cantonese, African drumming workshops and an exhibition of more than 900 student artworks. Admission is free. The Hong Kong Tourism Board listed the main venue as Victoria Park.

zh.headline: 渣打藝趣嘉年華周末重返銅鑼灣維園
zh.dek: 香港青年藝術協會舉辦的免費戶外青年藝術活動本周六日舉行，設有燈光夜巡遊及盛大閉幕巡遊，維多利亞公園亦有工作坊及演出。
body: 香港青年藝術協會於11月14及15日在銅鑼灣舉辦渣打藝趣嘉年華，以童話故事為主題，活動免費入場。
主辦方表示，周六晚上8時30分燈光夜巡遊由利園一期正門起步，展出本地藝術家創作的五個巨型燈光木偶、逾150名表演者，以及歷來最多的嘉年華服飾。
周日下午2時30分盛大閉幕巡遊由維多利亞公園出發，十個四米高巨型木偶領頭，約500名表演者包括本地學生參與。
維園現場設有互動藝術攤位、現場演出、中英雙語說故事、非洲鼓工作坊及逾900件學生作品展覽。香港旅遊發展局資料顯示主要場地為維多利亞公園。
